about_the_game:
"A really fun homage to Final Fantasy Tactics! I appreciated the creative ways that football mechanics/themes blended with the famous FFT movement system." -- ljwestmaas

"A clever mix of sports and strategy… it shows strong potential for fans of both strategy games and football." -- Massimo Solo

"It's like Blood Bowl had an FFT system rather than dice rolls" -- Nutlaw

Story

A magical and turn-based tactical football RPG where victory comes from outscoring, not destroying your opponents. Enjoy a single player adventure where four friends are whisked away to a fantasy realm of peace, where weapons and war are ancient history. Eager to find a way home, our heroes form a team and challenge the locals in turn-based sport. They soon learn of Queen Versephone, the powerful and benevolent leader of this realm, who can help them return home, but only if they become champions of the land!

Build and customize your ultimate fantasy team, unlock 64 abilities, and conquer 16 diverse battlefields in turn-based tactical combat!

Features

  • 4v4 turn-based tactical football matches with deep strategic gameplay.

  • Single player Adventure Mode with level up/stat growth, ability unlocking, and story progression mechanics.

  • Unlock and learn 64 powerful abilities as you quest across 16 diverse playfields in the Queendom.

  • Build your team from 8 distinct Positions (similar to classes or jobs in traditional RPGs).

  • Deal damage to opponents to force SUPER FUMBLES that fly across the field.

  • Built-in Rewind and Undo Move features let you try again easily.

  • Challenge a friend near or far in Local and Remote Play Together PVP.

  • Each playfield is lovingly handcrafted with a 1990's low-poly aesthetic.

Gameplay

The core mechanics of Fantasy Football Tactics will be familiar to fans of tactics RPGs. Each unit can Move and Act once per turn. On offense, you can Pitch the ball to a teammate or use a special Thrower ability to launch a Bullet downfield to score.

On defense, you can whittle down the ball carrier's health using physical and magical attacks to force a fumble. Recover the ball to get back on offense and score! There are loads of abilities you can use to move the ball, manipulate turn order, traverse long distances, buff your allies, debuff your opponents, deal damage, heal, and much more!

Super Abilities

Taking damage will charge your SUPER meter. When fully charged, a unit can unleash a powerful SUPER ability to upend a match. All 8 positions come equipped with their own unique SUPER ability. The Thrower's Perfect Pass allows you to throw the ball to any teammate anywhere on the field and guarantee their turn comes next. The Defender's Truck can instantly WALLOP any opponent. A perfectly timed SUPER can turn certain defeat into a sudden victory!

Build Your Fantasy Team

All units can Move, Tackle and Pitch the ball, but the real strategy comes from their distinct Position abilities. Once learned, abilities can be used even after changing to another Position allowing you to mix and match freely to customize your build. e.g. you could build a healer who can throw the ball downfield, or a powerful defender that has both physical and magical attacks. What strategy will you use to become champions? You can choose from the following 8 Positions:

  • Balancer: Healing

  • Thrower: Forward Passes

  • Striker: Fast Movement

  • Caster: Ranged Magic

  • Blocker: Tank and Disrupt

  • Defender: Strong Tackles

  • Supporter: Team Buffs

  • Gamebreaker: Wild Card
